scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --reload-dir app --port 8000
scripts.lint: turbo lint && cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.lint:fix: turbo lint -- --fix && cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . --fix && uv run ruff format .
scripts.test: turbo test && cd apps/api && uv run pytest
scripts.infra:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.db:migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:generate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic revision --autogenerate -m
scripts.db:reset: cd apps/api && uv run alembic downgrade base && uv run alembic upgrade head
